title: Mesangial Index Quantification
author: Frank Brosius
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8e7hthn
materials: Using the camera or MetaMorph® software digitize 15 cortical glomeruli per case with a 40 X lens. Glomeruli should be chosen for a similar diameter of maximal size. Save images as uncompressed tiff files.

steps.title: Open and Scale Image
steps.instruction: Open the glomerulus tiff file in MetaMorph® and scale the image to 50-75% so the entire glomerulus is visible on the screen.

steps.title: Outline Glomerular Tuft
steps.instruction: Carefully outline the glomerular tuft using the polygon tool, double-clicking to close the polygon.

steps.title: Calibrate Distances
steps.instruction: Calibrate the image distances based on the specific camera used.

substeps.instruction: Select Measure from the tool bar
Select Calibrate Distances
Choose the calibration file for the camera from which the image was taken in the Apply window
Choose Apply

steps.title: Measure Glomerulus Area
steps.instruction: Calculate and record the area of the glomerular tuft.

substeps.instruction: Select Measure from the tool bar
Select Region Measurements
Record the displayed glomerulus area

steps.title: Isolate Glomerular Tuft
steps.instruction: Remove the tuft from the background to prepare for PAS stain area calculation.

substeps.instruction: Select the outlined tuft
Choose Edit, Duplicate, Image from the tool bar
Close the full size image

steps.title: Configure Color Thresholding
steps.instruction: Set up the color threshold parameters to identify PAS staining.

substeps.instruction: Select Measure and then Set Color Threshold from the tool bar
Select Set By Example in the Set Color Threshold window
Use Display on the tool bar and Adjust Digital Contrast to optimize color brightness and contrast for thresholding

steps.title: Select PAS Stained Areas
steps.instruction: Highlight all PAS stained pixels while ensuring no non-stained tissue is selected.

substeps.instruction: Use the cursor to click on areas of staining until the entire PAS stained area is highlighted
Use 'Undo Last Click' in the Set Color Threshold box to remove mistaken selections
Check 'Reset color threshold range on next click' to clear all selections
Toggle between selected and unselected screens using OFF and Inclusive in the Set Color Threshold box

steps.title: Perform Morphometry Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze the selected area to determine the total PAS staining area.

substeps.instruction: Choose Measure and then Integrated Morphometry Analysis
In the Set Up Parameters For section, choose Measuring -> Total Area and Classifying -> Total Area
Choose Measure
Record the 'area of PAS staining' from the last cell in the Summary window under Total

steps.title: Close Analysis Tool
steps.instruction: Exit the Integrated Morphometry Analysis box.

substeps.instruction: Choose Reset Current
Choose Close
